summary: Independent hosted read-only audit of source commit a060ddd531753b3ed8bcd339ea8cc8a907ac6d7c and unchanged core digest cf9c1d1ce0c04793a293a38459e2567f528bb71eb89e3f8c7f5182638416fd17. Boundaries, aggregate ownership, receipt/feed atomicity, legacy replay, migration ordering and restore controls are coherent with the cited accepted ADRs or explicitly identified proposed amendments. One important gap remains: the selected SSE notification channel has no enumerated wire contract or server implementation owner in the slice map, leaving SC-004 dependent on an unspecified cross-tier component. Pending human approvals and unmeasured Rust/FFI sizing are disclosed prerequisites, not falsely claimed evidence. This hosted audit is not an official canonical gate pass; six CLI executions failed on proxy 403 and the formal campaign remains escalated. Reviewed files include targeted source reads and repository searches.

findings.description: The proposal selects authenticated SSE to satisfy the hint-enabled p95 <=2-second convergence requirement, but the normative sync contract never enumerates its endpoint or event schema and no server slice implements/publishes that channel. PR-40 only owns Rust client transport and subscriptions; the server API/feed slices own commands, capabilities and delta/transfer routes. Following the current map leaves the other active device relying on the allowed 30-second poll interval after a remote commit, so the hint-enabled SC-004 path cannot be delivered as specified. This is a missing component of the selected transport, not a request for an additional notification technology.
evidence: specs/026-rust-core-sync/plan.md:207 selects authenticated SSE carrying a scope-change notification and generation.
specs/026-rust-core-sync/spec.md:137 requires p95 <=2 s with the notification channel enabled; the fallback is a separate <=60 s promise.
specs/026-rust-core-sync/contracts/sync-v1.md:111-119 enumerates the proposed sync routes without any SSE/hint endpoint; section 11 defines the other wire envelopes but no SSE event.
specs/026-rust-core-sync/tasks.md:85-87 and PR-31/PR-32 at lines 1245 and 1280 assign server command/capability/delta/transfer work without SSE publishing.
specs/026-rust-core-sync/tasks.md:1563-1590 gives PR-40 only rust/crates/bb-client paths and client transport checks.

backend/app/api/__init__.py:11-17 mounts current task/Review routers; targeted search of backend/app/api, backend/app/modules/tasks and backend/app/main.py found no existing text/event-stream, EventSourceResponse or task SSE route to reuse.
findings.recommendation: Add the already-selected SSE endpoint and content-free scope/generation event to sync-v1, with its authentication/generation and reconnect semantics, and assign post-commit server hint publication plus client consumption to explicit bounded paths/dependencies in the existing slice map. Attach the existing SC-004 hint-enabled convergence check to that complete server/client path. Keep polling and lost-hint recovery as currently specified; no new product decision is needed.
